description: Source code for account move line management in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including models, methods, constraints, and view definitions related to accounting entries.

classes.name: account_move_line
classes.description: Model representing accounting move lines with methods for querying, default values, analytic line creation, reconciliation, and view management.

classes.name: account_bank_statement_reconcile
classes.description: Extension of account.bank.statement.reconcile with additional line references.

methods.name: _query_get
methods.description: Constructs SQL query conditions for fetching move lines based on context filters.

methods.name: default_get
methods.description: Provides default values for new move line records.

methods.name: create_analytic_lines
methods.description: Creates analytic lines linked to move lines if analytic account is set.

methods.name: _default_get_move_form_hook
methods.description: Removes certain fields during manual move line entry.

methods.name: _default_get
methods.description: Computes default values for move lines, including manual entry and move context.

methods.name: _get_date
methods.description: Determines default date for move lines based on context or latest move.

methods.name: _get_currency
methods.description: Returns the currency of the journal for default currency assignment.

methods.name: onchange_currency
methods.description: Updates debit and credit fields based on selected currency and account.

methods.name: onchange_partner_id
methods.description: Updates date maturity and account based on partner and journal.

methods.name: onchange_account_id
methods.description: Sets tax id based on account and partner.

methods.name: reconcile_partial
methods.description: Reconciles partial move lines, creating a partial reconciliation record.

methods.name: reconcile
methods.description: Performs full reconciliation of move lines, including write-offs and currency adjustments.

methods.name: view_header_get
methods.description: Generates header string for move line views based on context.

methods.name: fields_view_get
methods.description: Generates dynamic XML view for move lines, especially in tree view with domain filters.

methods.name: _check_moves
methods.description: Checks if the first move for a journal and period is still in draft state.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes move lines with validation and move validation.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Updates move lines with validation, currency adjustments, and move validation.

methods.name: _update_journal_check
methods.description: Ensures journal and period are open for modifications.

methods.name: _update_check
methods.description: Validates move lines before modification, checking move state and reconciliation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates move lines, handling move creation, tax, currency, and analytic lines.
